notes: Parts are unchanged from step 1; none added or dropped.
Circuit: 5V -> red wire -> + rail -> red wire -> button side 2 (column 8); button side 1 (column 6) -> blue wire to Leonardo pin 4; 10k resistor from the pin-4 column (6) to the GND rail (pull-down).

The image shows the button spanning the centre gap in columns 6 and 8. Pin 4 (column 6) and 5V (column 8) must be on opposite button sides, so side 1 (1.l, 1.r) is placed in column 6 (6t.e and 6b.f) and side 2 (2.l, 2.r) in column 8 (8t.e and 8b.f). This differs from the catalogue's generic leg order.

Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue: the half with the wires, labelled a-e in the image, is bank 't'; the button's other legs are in bank 'b' row f. Rail positions (bn.3, bn.7, bp.4, bp.9) are estimated from the image, with the bottom rail pair's upper row as ground (-) and lower row as + (5V).
The schematic labels the input as pin 2 but the text and circuit image use pin 4; pin 4 is used.
The Leonardo GND wire is placed on GND.1, the GND next to 5V in the image.
